PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Chairman, Salesforce Agentblazer Club PRESENT 
Leading the official Salesforce campus club at Sri Eshwar College of Engineering 
- Organizing workshops, bootcamps, and certification drives on Salesforce, Agentforce, Agentic AI, and Cloud Computing for 100+ students. 
- Conducting hackathons and expert sessions to bridge academia with industry, building real-world AI and CRM skills beyond classroom learning. 
Tensorik Technologies Pvt. Ltd. APR - JUL 2026 
Software Engineer Intern — Full-Stack 
- Spearheaded a full production migration of a live EdTech platform (40,000+ subscribers) from MERN to Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, and Supabase 
(PostgreSQL), shipping 28+ server-rendered pages and 13 REST APIs in a pnpm monorepo across 147 commits. 
- Architected a production-grade B2B e-commerce platform (220+ files, 34K+ LOC) with a secure Razorpay checkout pipeline — idempotent order creation, 
atomic stock reservation via PostgreSQL RPCs, HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, and cron-based expired-stock release via GitHub Actions. 
- Engineered RBAC (user/admin/superadmin) across both platforms using Supabase Row -Level Security, middleware route guards, and email -verification 
enforcement, reducing unauthorized data exposure to zero across 125+ combined DB migrations. 
- Delivered a 14+ module admin dashboard (product/variant CRUD, order lifecycle, Recharts analytics, coupon engine, review moderation, audit logs) and a full 
CI/CD pipeline — GitHub Actions, Docker multi-stage builds, and GCP Cloud Run deployment with Vercel as hot standby. 
Open-Source Contributor JUN - 2026 
microsoft/playwright (67.6k Stars) | microsoft/presidio (9.8k Stars) | Hacktoberfest 
- Contributed Docker Compose runtime fixes and healthceeheck improvements to microsoft/presidio, enhancing container reliability for PII detection pipelines. 
- Resolved glob brace pattern validation bug in microsoft/playwright, improving cross-platform test configuration accuracy. 
PROJECTS 
AI-POWERED ENTERPRISE MCP WORKFLOW PROXY GITHUB Jun 2026 
- Built a universal schema parser normalizing OpenAPI, GraphQL, gRPC via Leiden Modularity + MiniLM embeddings into 5 –6 endpoint workflows, cutting 
LLM token footprint by 83.2%; a schema-aware DAG builder with Tarjan's cycle detection (O((N+E)(C+1))) and JSONPath variable mapping. 
- Engineered dynamic FastMCP hot -reload via inspect.Signature, preserving 95%+ prompt headroom; a FastPreFilter regex guardrail cut injection -detection 
latency 97.5% (150ms → <5ms) at 0 MB VRAM; SHA-256 caching reduced latency 99.8% (200ms → <1ms). 
- Delivered a 20,531-LOC platform (103 Python + 44 TypeScript/TSX), with a Next.js 15 + React 19 dashboard featuring live Leiden graph visualizati on and 
Prometheus metrics export. 
 
AI AGENTS WITH MCP SERVER INTEGRATION GITHUB Jun 2026 
- Built five MCP servers connecting AI assistants to Wayback Machine, Pinterest, Unipile, and Omnisearch, enabling real -time web archival lookup, visual 
search, messaging, and content aggregation. 
- Deployed AI agents on the Vanij platform with multi-tool MCP integration, enabling access to external services and real-time data pipelines. 
 
AI-POWERED PARAMETRIC INSURANCE PLATFORM GITHUB Apr – May 2026 
- Deployed a 4-model ML pipeline (XGBoost, LightGBM, GBDT, Isolation Forest) on 136,000+ telemetry rows, serving inference in <80ms, 94% Redis cache 
hit rate, and fraud AUC 0.965; auto-settled ₹800–₹1,200 payouts in <2 min via a 3-stage RazorpayX handshake with SHA-256 idempotency locks. 
- Hardened claims with an 8-layer fraud pipeline (IMU σ² <0.5, GPS >120 km/h, barometric sensors) blocking spoofed claims in <5s; enforced DPDP 2023 & 
IRDAI compliance at the DB layer, sustaining 1.47 BCR across 333 H3 Res-8 zones. 
- Delivered a 52,545-LOC full-stack platform — 166 REST endpoints, 26 DB tables, and 4 microservices (React Native, NestJS, FastAPI, Vite dashboard). 
 
ACHIEVEMENTS 
Adya AI Hackathon — Winner (100K INR award: 50K cash + 50K AWS credits + Pre-Placement Offer) 
Amazon ML Summer School 2026 — Selected participant, MLSS 2026. 
Top 10, Guidewire DEVTrails Hackathon 2026 out of 4,500+ participating teams nationwide. 
Flash Coder Award 2026 — SCIPC top honors for speed and accuracy; outperformed 3,000+ competitors. 
HackTheRank Challenges: Achieved Rank 45 in the elimination round and secured a Top 208 Finalist position in the global achievement challenge. 
CODING PROFILES 
LeetCode : Solved 510+ problems | Contest Rating: 1708 | Global Rank: 110,750 Link 
CodeChef : Solved 350+ problems | Got Silver Badge Link 
SkillRack : Solved 1500+ problems | Rank: 8355 | Received 460+ Bronzes Link 
Codeforces : Solved 50+ problems | Newbie | Rating: 353 Link 
CERTIFICATIONS 
Mastering Data Structures and Algorithm using C & C++ Udemy May 2025 
SQL (Advanced) HackerRank May 2025 
Artificial Intelligence: ML Corizo Feb 2025 
Diploma in Python Fullstack Developer (DFPD) CSC Jan 2025 
Certified in C, C++ programming IIT Bombay Dec 2024 
TECH SKILLS 
Languages : C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL 
Frontend : React.js, Redux, Next.js, React Native, Tailwind CSS 
Backend : NestJS, Node.js, Spring Boot, Express.js, FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, WebSockets 
Databases : PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Prisma ORM 
DevOps : Git, Docker, Kafka, CI/CD, Vercel, Postman, Firebase 
CS Core : Data Structures & Algorithms, Computer Networks, Operating Systems, OOPs
